subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: Is a fixed five-minute maximum for existing MS Teams SharePoint content uploads an acceptable compatibility and delivery tradeoff?
rationale: The timeout fixes an indefinite hang, but selecting a finite transfer ceiling intentionally changes the outcome for exceptionally slow valid uploads and cannot be settled by unit tests or green CI alone.

options.title: Accept five-minute ceiling
options.body: Land the current bounded behavior because it preserves uploads beyond the prior 30-second window while preventing indefinite pending sends.

options.title: Adjust the transfer deadline
options.body: Choose a different fixed upload budget before merge and update the focused timeout tests and proof to match.

recommendation.title: Accept five-minute ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the current bounded behavior because it preserves uploads beyond the prior 30-second window while preventing indefinite pending sends.
